Big news for all my Rho Agenda fans—The Ripper’s Son audiobook is officially in production and will be available exclusively on Audible starting June 10, 2025!

I’ve heard from so many of you who loved the Kindle and paperback editions and were eagerly awaiting the audio version. I’m thrilled to let you know it’s on the way—and it’s going to be a wild ride. With the same high-stakes pacing, mind-bending tech, and emotional intensity that define the Rho Agenda universe, this audiobook will bring Rob Gregory’s story to life like never before. The voice talent on this project is top-notch, and I can’t wait for you to hear how he brings these characters—and their conflicts—to your ears.

For those who’ve already devoured the book, thank you. Your support means everything. If you enjoyed The Ripper’s Son, I’d be incredibly grateful if you could take a moment to leave an honest review on Amazon.com. Reviews help new readers discover the story and make a world of difference to independent authors like me.

And if you haven’t read the book yet—now’s a great time to dive in before the audiobook drops. With advanced AI, rogue subminds, and a protagonist who can feel the pulse of the digital world, The Ripper’s Son is a high-voltage thriller that sets the stage for what comes next in the Rho Agenda universe.

More updates soon—including a sneak peek of the audiobook. Stay tuned!

— Richard Phillips
